structuralHypothesis: A tax-canonical acronym with no material competing ordinary sense (MCIT, RCIT, NOLCO, IAET, SLSP) used as the requested tax concept is self-resolving and needs its own rule, since for a bare token neither the surrounding-tax-word test nor the authority-term test can fire. Genuinely polysemous tokens such as DST and VAT are excluded and still CLARIFY without context. An explanatory verb over a tax instrument in explicit BIR context is a definition request, not a non-tax action. Styling and programming artefacts govern their own target, matched on computing-qualified forms so an ordinary noun like a culture class is unaffected.
